title: Minehut Utilities
description: This is a plugin specifically designed for Minehut Minecraft servers. Minehut Utilities lets you enable or disable the Minehut chat filter & cosmetics (as well as giving all the cosmetics).
body:
![Plugin Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1809b32311196195d82ba5db9a69f11875171b79.png)
**Minehut Utilities** is a plugin... which provides utilities for servers hosted on Minehut. 
## 2 Utilities:
- Disable the Minehut chat filter
- Disable the Minehut cosmetics (OR give anyone who joins all cosmetics.. including Staff-Exclusive Cosmetics if wanted).

## Configurable via a config:
```yaml
Minehut:
  Filter:
    enabled: false # filter BEGONE (mostly, stuff like join <thing> will ig get like blocked by the proxy or sum idk)
  Cosmetics:
    enabled: true # cosmetics... whether they exist or not
    everyoneIsAdmin: false # unlock extra cosmetics
    everyoneIsMod: false # unlocks less extra cosmetics
    giveAll: false # give all purchasable cosmetics for free
```
**<ins>Provided configurations are the defaults.</ins>**

That's.. it yea.

Also if you want to edit some.... (_<ins>you can only edit the motd :sob:</ins>_) parts of the server the player sees in their server list (multiplayer list, not in the minehut lobby), you can use my [other plugin](https://modrinth.com/plugin/culplugin) for that.
